seed 1
compare records dump=n node=depth,label,tag,props text=depth,value ops=create,write,addListener,removeListener log=text
explain node:tag=R1
requirement R1 createDom makes an element whose tag is the element's type
requirement R2 `children` and `key` are never assigned to the node, on create or on update
requirement R3 A TEXT_ELEMENT becomes a text node: created empty, then `nodeValue` is written like any prop
requirement R4 Props are assigned as properties of the node, on create and when they are new on update
requirement R5 A prop whose name starts with `on` becomes a listener of the lower-cased rest of the name, and is not also assigned as a property
requirement R6 updateDom writes only the props that are new or have a different value, falsy values included
requirement R7 A prop that is gone from the new props is written as an empty string
requirement R8 A changed handler loses its old listener and gets a new one, an unchanged one is left alone, a removed one is removed
requirement R9 updateDom on a text node writes a changed `nodeValue`, and clears it when it is gone
requirement E2E Mixed sequences of create, update, click and ops
